classification: metric implementation error, not a scientific-threshold failure

correction.data_constrained_source_cell: a source cell whose column in the final whitened image operator has nonzero Euclidean norm
correction.occupied_fraction: fraction of data-constrained cells whose absolute source value is at least one percent of the maximum absolute value among data-constrained cells
correction.edge_flux_fraction: absolute fitted source flux in data-constrained outer-row or outer-column cells divided by total absolute fitted flux in all data-constrained cells
